rules: Use edited output as the display basis.
Remove separator X; ignore spacing and punctuation; fold case and German umlauts to AE/OE/UE.
Do not expand abbreviations, replace literal labels, normalize place names or delete unknown positions.
Every displayed question mark is one unresolved label, not grammatical punctuation.

limits: Seven physical source parts, not seven independent first decipherments. Published period-key authorship and earlier OCR candidate work are retained.
The Nov7-9 published square has two missing cells, jointly assigned5/6 in compatibility witnesses; neither completion is selected historically and no published key is changed.
Observed substitutions, printed-mask fills, observed exclusions and excluded masks are distinct costs. No new coordinates are inserted.
